document_authority_hierarchy: 1. Addenda & Clarifications supersede everything they touch. Addendum #1 (05.06.26) reissued G0-00, LS1-10, A1-20, A2-10, A10-30, C1 and GD. Exhibit B Basis of GMP (07.01.26) is a contract document treated as an addendum (PM ruling 08.04.26).
2. The Scope of Work narrative decides WHICH PACKAGE carries an item. It is the trade-boundary authority.
3. Specifications decide HOW the work is executed.
4. Drawings show extent and location. Weakest authority for assignment.

Subcontractor proposals are NOT in this hierarchy. They surface the assumptions a bidder made and expose gaps. Where a proposal contradicts a contract document, FLAG it -- never silently adopt the proposal's position or narrow the subcontract to match it. Ignore general/boilerplate exclusions.

exclusions_scope_specific: We exclude the following items (unless specifically included in the scope of work on this proposal):
Opening preparation, miscellaneous steel, steel tube supports, access panels; finish painting; counter tops, sills or thresholds; protection of our
products and work after installation for damage or loss resulting from other tradesmen or any other jobsite circumstance beyond our control;
mounting of control equipment (push button stations, etc.), coding of radio transmitters, field wiring of both controls and line voltage, conduit,
wire, disconnect switches or any other electrical work or material; smoke detectors or interconnection of fire doors to central alarm systems;
sawcutting of driveway or laying in and sealing of buried loop wires; welding performed by certified welders; permits and bonds; or other items
or work not specified to be included on within our Proposal scope.
Security Alarms: In the course of our work if existing security alarm connections are made to the door or gate that we are servicing we will
attempt to keep those connections undisturbed or place them back on the new door/gate in a similar fashion to how they had been placed
originally. However, should there be any issue with the alarm connections Lawrence Doors will not be responsible for the alarm operation and
the customer, at their own expense, should contact their alarm company to restore any alarm connections as needed.
Labor Provisions: Work is to be performed by installers provided by Lawrence Roll-Up Doors, Inc. at their regular rates of pay (unless
prevailing wages are indicated as included on this Proposal) during normal business hours Monday to Friday unless otherwise stated. Labor may
be subcontracted to another licensed subcontractor, which may include an owner/operator (whose compensation is in the form of draws that
meet or exceed prevailing wage rates, when applicable). Any and all references to union labor, wages, benefits, programs or other provisions
related to organized labor are excluded. Unrestricted use, free of obstructions, foot and vehicular traffic in the doorway, and a reasonable space
adjacent to the door opening must be assured to perform our work as agreed.

open_pm_items.title: Door 106 panic hardware exclusion is ambiguous
open_pm_items.detail: The exclusion reads: 'Panic hardware at Door 106 per Door Schedule Remark 2. Hardware provided per specification section 08711 Door Hardware, Hardware Set 01'. It is unclear whether panic hardware is excluded outright, or whether Remark 2's hardware is excluded and Hardware Set 01 substituted. Door 106 is the concessions overhead counter shutter area and this is a life-safety item.
